body.statement: For every distribution of \(O\) that is the observed-data pushforward of at least one law in \(\mathfrak M_H\), every such sustained-arm full-data extension, and every \(\gamma\in\mathcal G_H(p_{BT},q)\), the explicit algorithm \(\mathfrak L\) produces a finite-horizon FFRCISTG law on raw nonnegative-integer count paths with triple margin \(\gamma\), the same pushforward distribution of \(O\), absorbing death, baseline randomization, and the same arm-specific sequential censoring continuation probabilities conditional on the factual at-risk histories \(\mathcal H_{\ell-1}^a\). On each constructed switched survivor branch the raw post-\(k\) increment is exactly \(W\); no global restriction bounds raw counts by \(H\). Conversely, every law in \(\mathfrak M_H\) induces a member of \(\mathcal G_H(p_{BT},q)\). The construction imposes neither censoring independence from the entire response tree nor any other cross-world independence beyond baseline randomization and the listed FFRCISTG conditions.
body.justification: Polyhedral sharpness is causal only if every extremal summary coupling can be realized by a global finite-horizon response tree without silently invoking an NPSEM cross-world product structure.
body.gap: GreseleEtAl2022 studies causal-marginal gluing and RichardsonRobins2013 distinguishes FFRCISTG from NPSEM models; neither supplies an observed-law-preserving recurrent-event lift with death and censoring.
body.consumer: Every endpoint and regret optimizer over the transport polytope is certified as attainable by a causal model rather than only by an abstract coupling.
body.proof_tex:
Let \(P_O\) be the stipulated observed distribution and let \(\mathsf P_0\in\mathfrak M_H\) be the particular admitted sustained-arm full-data extension named in the theorem.  Write \(U_0\) for its response table.  Because the horizon is finite and every raw-count coordinate is integer valued, the response-type space is countable; all conditional kernels used below therefore exist by elementary discrete disintegration.

First retain, jointly and without modification, the two sustained raw histories from \(U_0\).  On \(\{S_k^1=1,B=b,T=t\}\), define a conditional draw \(\widetilde W\) by
\[
 \mathsf P(\widetilde W=w\mid U_0)
 =\frac{\gamma_{btw}}{p_{bt}}\quad\text{when }p_{bt}>0.    \tag{1}
\]
When \(p_{bt}=0\), that conditioning event has probability zero and the conditional law may be chosen arbitrarily.  Since \(\sum_w\gamma_{btw}=p_{bt}\), (1) is a probability mass function.  Moreover,
\[
 \mathsf P(B=b,T=t,\widetilde W=w\mid S_k^1=1)
 =p_{bt}\frac{\gamma_{btw}}{p_{bt}}=\gamma_{btw}           \tag{2}
\]
on positive cells, and both sides vanish on zero cells.  Thus the desired triple margin is obtained.  Summing (2) over \(b,t\) gives
\[
 \mathsf P(\widetilde W=w\mid S_k^1=1)=q_w.               \tag{3}
\]

We next construct a legal switched raw history.  Through time \(k\), copy the sustained intensive history exactly.  If it is dead at \(k\), continue the absorbing death state and make no later count increment.  If it is alive at \(k\), keep it alive through \(K\), let its raw count jump by exactly \(\widetilde W\) at time \(k+1\), and keep the count constant thereafter.  This is well defined because \(K\ge k+1\), multiple events in one interval are allowed, and \(\widetilde W\in\mathbb I_H\).  It is nondecreasing, death is absorbing, and its raw post-landmark increment equals \(\widetilde W\).  Therefore its separately capped increment is also \(W=\widetilde W\).  The support restriction on \(\gamma\) gives
\[
 \mathsf P(B+W\le H\mid S_k^1=1)=1.                       \tag{4}
\]
Notice that if the retained raw count at \(k\) already exceeds \(H\), then \(B=H\), so (4) forces \(W=0\); the raw count itself is left unchanged and need not be bounded by \(H\).

To complete the whole finite response tree, index a node by its treatment prefix.  Put the retained sustained histories and the newly constructed switched history on their corresponding nodes.  These prescriptions agree whenever their treatment prefixes agree: in particular, the intensive and switched branches agree through \(k\) by construction, and the two retained sustained branches already came from the valid table \(U_0\).  Traverse all remaining prefix nodes in increasing time order.  At an unset child, copy its parent's count and death state; if the parent is alive, append a zero-event alive continuation, and if it is dead, append the absorbing state.  Because every node has a unique treatment prefix, this recursion assigns one state to each prefix and therefore enforces the FFRCISTG no-anticipation requirement.  It also preserves nondecreasing integer counts and absorbing death on every branch.  Denote the resulting table by \(U'\).  This is the explicit action of \(\mathfrak L\).

It remains to verify randomization, censoring, and the observed pushforward.  One convenient joint construction is to sample \((U_0,R,C)\) with its original law \(\mathsf P_0\), then sample the auxiliary draw in (1) conditionally on \(U_0\) but not on \(R\), and finally form \(U'\).  For every response-table event \(E\) and arm \(a\), baseline randomization under \(\mathsf P_0\) gives
\[
 \begin{aligned}
 \mathsf P(U'\in E,R=a)
 &=\int \mathsf P(U'\in E\mid U_0=u)\,
       \mathsf P_0(R=a,U_0\in du)\\
 &=\mathsf P_0(R=a)\int \mathsf P(U'\in E\mid U_0=u)\,
       \mathsf P_0(U_0\in du)\\
 &=\mathsf P_0(R=a)\mathsf P(U'\in E).
 \end{aligned}                                             \tag{5}
\]
Thus \(R\perp U'\), and the original positive assignment probabilities are retained.

For \(R=0\) or \(R=1\), the factual sustained branch of \(U'\) is exactly that of \(U_0\).  We also retain the original \(C\).  Consequently
\[
 (R,C,\mathcal H_K^R)\ \text{has exactly the same law under the construction as under }\mathsf P_0. \tag{6}
\]
Consistency then makes the path truncated at \(C\), and hence \(O\), identical under the two laws.  This proves preservation of the complete observed pushforward, not merely of a terminal summary.  Equation (6) also shows, for every factual at-risk history on which it is defined, that
\[
 \begin{aligned}
 &\mathsf P(C\ge\ell\mid R=a,C\ge\ell-1,D_{\ell-1}^a=0,
                    \mathcal H_K^a)\\
 &\qquad=\mathsf P_0(C\ge\ell\mid R=a,C\ge\ell-1,D_{\ell-1}^a=0,
                    \mathcal H_K^a)\\
 &\qquad=\mathsf P_0(C\ge\ell\mid R=a,C\ge\ell-1,D_{\ell-1}^a=0,
                    \mathcal H_{\ell-1}^a)\\
 &\qquad=\mathsf P(C\ge\ell\mid R=a,C\ge\ell-1,D_{\ell-1}^a=0,
                    \mathcal H_{\ell-1}^a),
 \end{aligned}                                             \tag{7}
\]
where the middle equality is censoring exchangeability for \(\mathsf P_0\).  Positivity is retained because the common quantity in (7) is the original strictly positive continuation probability.  Equivalently, (6) may be generated by the original sequence of factual-history continuation kernels, including the original post-death convention.  Retaining the joint law in (6), rather than postulating an independence factorization for \(C\), makes clear that no independence of censoring from unassigned counterfactual branches is required.

Equations (2)--(7), together with the prefix construction, verify respectively the triple margin, capped residual transportability, capacity, no anticipation, absorbing death, baseline randomization, consistency, assignment and censoring positivity, sequential coarsening at random, and observed-law preservation.  These are exactly the restrictions defining \(\mathfrak M_H\).  The convenient auxiliary kernel in (1) may happen to create additional conditional independences in this particular witness, but none is assumed or required: one may couple unused-branch completion randomizers with \(\widetilde W\) while retaining (2)--(7), so the maintained class gains no cross-world independence restriction.

Conversely, let \(\mathsf P\in\mathfrak M_H\).  Define
\[
 \gamma_{btw}=\mathsf P(B=b,T=t,W=w\mid S_k^1=1).          \tag{8}
\]
Landmark-survival positivity makes this conditioning well defined.  Its \((B,T)\) margin is \(p_{bt}\); capped residual transportability makes its \(W\) margin \(q_w\); and capped capacity makes (8) vanish when \(b+w>H\).  Hence \(\gamma\in\mathcal G_H(p_{BT},q)\), proving the converse.
